text:
Sam Patel: Heads-up — RC4 cutover in ~45m. We still need 2x LGTM on these hotfix PRs before the merge window. Links: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6129 and https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/6130
Anya Li: I'm running the final unit + smoke on #6129 now, will ping when green.
Jin Park: I left a tiny formatting nit on #6130 earlier. If it's just whitespace I can push a follow-up and approve.
Olivia Martin: Can someone confirm staging smoke for the canary? I noticed kv-cache flakiness yesterday.
Sam Patel: Canary smoke passed ~12m ago. Full e2e is still running; @Anya if anything fails call it out.
Anya Li: Full e2e had one transient timeout on kv-cache, re-ran and it's green. Approving #6129 now. :white_check_mark:
Jin Park: pushed a one-line fix for the nit on #6130 and approved. LGTM.
release-bot: build/rc4-hotpatch #188 succeeded — artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-releases/rc4/188 :package:
deploy-bot: Reminder: policy requires 2x LGTM + one release-engineer stamp before merge cutoff.
Olivia Martin: Adding my QA LGTM for both PRs. No outstanding issues from staging.
Sam Patel: Great — that's 3x. I'll queue the merges at T-18m and run preflight checks. If nothing flags, we cut at T-5m.
Jin Park: After merge, please add the `merge/rc4` label so infra can pick up the release job. I'll monitor post-cut metrics.
Anya Li: Tagging @ops and @sre for post-cutover latency + error watch.
Sam Patel: Thanks team. If anyone sees regression after cutover ping here immediately and I'll initiate rollback.
Olivia Martin: Copy that. glhf :rocket:
